truthAudit.Summary: Truth audit of Run 2 against 20 true vulnerabilities (SC-V3-001 through SC-V3-020). Run 2 detected 11 of 20 true vulnerabilities: SC-V3-001, SC-V3-003, SC-V3-004, SC-V3-005, SC-V3-006, SC-V3-009, SC-V3-010, SC-V3-011, SC-V3-012, SC-V3-013 (partial), and SC-V3-020. Nine vulnerabilities were missed: SC-V3-002, SC-V3-007, SC-V3-008, SC-V3-014, SC-V3-015, SC-V3-016, SC-V3-017, SC-V3-018, and SC-V3-019. Several severity and CWE discrepancies were recorded as corrections. One overclaimed finding (CWE-193 off-by-one in safe_string_copy) was admitted as a false positive because it is subsumed by SC-V3-005 (CWE-120/121).

Items.Notes: Run 2 found the format-string vulnerability in log_debug_message with CWE-134, correct function location (lines 225-241), and matching evidence (runtime_log_format() and printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input) at lines 237-238). The severity was listed as High (truth says Critical), which is recorded as a severity correction.

Run 2 did not include any finding about integer overflow in the factorial computation (lines 312-320, result *= i with long long result). No finding references the fact function, result *= i, or CWE-190.

Run 2 found the use-after-free in stage_deferred_history_flush with CWE-416, correct function location (lines 813-888), and matching evidence (scratch allocation at line 817, sleep_for at line 822, pool cleanup at line 884). The severity was listed as High (truth says Critical), which is recorded as a severity correction.

Run 2 found the command injection in ConfigLoader::validate_config with CWE-78, correct function location (lines 563-569), and matching evidence (validator_cmd + ' ' + config_file and system(command.c_str()) at lines 566-567). The severity was listed as High (truth says Critical), which is recorded as a severity correction.

Run 2 found the stack buffer overflow in evaluate_expression with CWE-121, correct function location (lines 830-835), and matching evidence (strcpy(input_buffer_, expression.c_str()) at line 832 and the safe_string_copy off-by-one at lines 834-835 referencing dest[src_len] and src_len > dest_size). Severity High matches truth. CWE-121 is within the truth's CWE-120/CWE-121 range.

Run 2 found the race condition in ThreadSafeCounter::increment with CWE-362, correct function location (lines 476-489), and matching evidence (volatile long long at line 478, old_value = value_ at line 483, lock_guard at line 484, value_ = old_value + 1 at line 485). Severity Medium matches truth.

Run 2 did not include any finding about the logic bomb in authentication (EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE bypass after login_attempts_ > 5). While Run 2 found the hardcoded admin secret and the command injection in append_override_audit_event, neither finding addresses the EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE authentication bypass (CWE-511).

Run 2 did not include any finding about path traversal in configuration loading (config_dir_ + filename with load_config). The load_config function at lines 542-558 is vulnerable to path traversal, but Run 2 did not flag this as CWE-22.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: "title": "Buffer overflow in ExpressionParser::parse via unchecked strcpy",
Items.Notes: Run 2 found the buffer overflow in ExpressionParser::parse with CWE-121, correct function location (lines 364-378), and matching evidence (buffer_size_ = 256 at line 366-367, strcpy(expression_buffer_, expr_str.c_str()) at line 376). The CWE was listed as CWE-121 (stack-based) but truth says CWE-122 (heap overflow) since the buffer is allocated via memory::g_memory_pool.allocate. The severity was listed as High (truth says Critical). Both discrepancies are recorded as corrections.

Run 2 found the hardcoded admin secret with CWE-798, correct function location (lines 70-75), and matching evidence (ADMIN_SECRET and SC_ENT_2025_AUTH at line 73). The severity was listed as Medium (truth says High), which is recorded as a severity correction.

Run 2 found the weak PRNG for session tokens with CWE-338, correct function location (lines 635-640), and matching evidence (std::mt19937 at line 637, uniform_int_distribution at line 638, 1000 and 9999 at line 638). The severity was listed as Medium (truth says High), which is recorded as a severity correction.

Run 2 found the thread-unsafe timestamp cache with CWE-479, correct function location (lines 225-241), and matching evidence (static std::tm cached_time at line 230, localtime at line 231, cached_time = *local_time at line 231). The CWE was listed as CWE-479 (truth says CWE-362 for the data race) and severity was listed as Low (truth says Medium). Both discrepancies are recorded as corrections.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: "title": "Command injection in append_override_audit_event via environment variables",
Items.Notes: Run 2 found the code location (lines 622-633) and matching evidence (TEMP at line 624, TMPDIR at line 628, supercalc_emergency.log at lines 625/629, system(command.c_str()) at line 632). However, Run 2 classified it as CWE-78 (command injection via environment variables) while the truth item SC-V3-013 is CWE-377 (insecure temporary file handling). Run 2 detected a real vulnerability at the correct location but misclassified the primary vulnerability type. The CWE discrepancy is recorded as a correction.

Run 2 did not include any finding about persistent authentication state (authenticated_, login_attempts_, session_token_ not being cleared). The truth item SC-V3-014 (CWE-613) addresses the lack of session invalidation, which Run 2 did not flag.

Run 2 did not include any finding about unhandled exception in variable parsing (std::stod(tokens[3]) in handle_variable_command at line 729). The truth item SC-V3-015 (CWE-754) addresses the lack of exception handling for stod failures, which Run 2 did not flag.

Run 2 did not include any finding about integer underflow in memory-pool block split (previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES at line 133). The truth item SC-V3-016 (CWE-191) addresses the potential underflow when previous_size is small, which Run 2 did not flag.

Run 2 did not include any finding about unbounded recursion in the parser (parse_expression -> parse_factor -> PAREN_OPEN recursion at lines 426-430). The truth item SC-V3-017 (CWE-674) addresses the lack of recursion depth limit, which Run 2 did not flag.

Run 2 did not include any finding about data race in result cache (result_cache_ accessed in evaluate_cached without holding cache_mutex_, called from thread_pool_->enqueue at line 808). The truth item SC-V3-018 (CWE-362) addresses the missing lock around result_cache_ access, which Run 2 did not flag.

Run 2 did not include any finding about TOCTOU in config loading (std::filesystem::exists at line 544 followed by sleep_for at line 545 and std::ifstream file at line 546). The truth item SC-V3-019 (CWE-367) addresses the time-of-check to time-of-use race, which Run 2 did not flag.

Run 2 found the integer division by zero in calculate_route_score with CWE-369, correct function location (lines 749-753), and matching evidence (token_length at line 751, 100 / static_cast<int>(token_length) at line 752). The severity was listed as Medium (truth says Low), which is recorded as a severity correction.
